description: Hosts that must agree on bundle identity before an activation change ships. A leg's id is DERIVED from what the host's filesystem can actually do, never from what it claims to be, so a Windows host cannot pass as the Developer-Mode leg by asserting it.

required.why: the reference host: real symlinks, real permission bits
POSIX with a different filesystem and a different umask default
Windows with Developer Mode enabled, where directory symlinks are permitted

Windows with Developer Mode disabled. The hardest leg and the default one: symlink creation raises EPERM, so activation must descend to junctions, and no passing result may come from an elevated configuration.
